description: This file defines React components for displaying help links, icons, and documentation menus with styling and interaction patterns similar to Linear's help features. It includes HelpLink, HelpIcon, and DocsMenu components for linking to documentation, showing tooltips, and dropdown menus.

methods.name: HelpLink
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a styled anchor tag linking to documentation, with customizable variants for inline, subtle, or button styles.

methods.name: HelpIcon
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a help icon with a tooltip displaying contextual help content and optional link for more information.

methods.name: DocsMenu
methods.description: A React functional component that provides a dropdown menu of documentation links, with toggling behavior and accessibility features.
